narrative:
Material PL3__M51FD567 exhibits erratic demand with a coefficient of variation of 62.69% and 93.4% non-zero demand days. 
Lead time is volatile (CV=79.96%, mean=1.13 days, std=0.90 days), with lead time variability contributing 65% of total demand-during-lead-time variance.

Current SAP policy maintains safety stock of 1153 units with minimum order quantity 1153, resulting in annual total cost of $20,346.05.

The optimized policy recommends:
- Safety stock: 2196 units (increase of 1043 units)
- Order quantity: 8182 units (constrained by storage capacity of 10378 units)
- Reorder point: 3540 units
- Review period: 6.9 days

This optimization reduces total annual inventory cost by $14,011.80 (68.9%), primarily through reduced ordering frequency (36 vs 258 orders/year).

The capacity constraint is binding, limiting order quantity to 8182 units instead of the unconstrained EOQ of 8820 units. The recommended safety lead time is 1.48 days to buffer against lead time volatility.
